title: Hubble SN 1987A: registered 1994–2006 time-lapse
question: How does the visible hotspot pattern change across the official Hubble sequence?
results: six official Hubble frames registered from 1994 to 2006
maximum measured registration shift 0.00 display pixels
bright connected ring regions change from 12 to 24 under one relative threshold
validation: Frames share the official release geometry, are checked by phase correlation, and use a within-frame relative threshold; calibrated brightness is deliberately not inferred.
provenance: six dated 1200-pixel derivatives of official TIFF frames
source URLs and dates recorded in data/sn1987a/manifest.json
limitations: release-frame stretches and colours may differ by epoch
JPEG pixels are not calibrated flux
connected-component count depends on threshold and release processing
